├── models/
│   ├── diffusion_models/
│   │   └─── flux1-dev.safetensors 
│   ├── text_encoders/

A striking, cinematic masterwork photograph of a young Argentine boy, aged 7, looking directly at the camera with a profound, serious, yet innocent gaze. He is dressed in a traditional yet high-tech functional worker's overall, made of natural Sky Blue and Pure White fabric, adorned with intricate traditional golden Fileteado Porteño spirals and acanthus leaf embroidery on the collar and chest. On his lapel, a large, detailed, polished golden 'Sun of May' brooch (serene face, 32 alternating rays) functions as a central, radiant ornament. The composition is a heroic low-angle. The background is a breathtaking Solarpunk-Expressionist Buenos Aires: towering, fluid white organic architectures covered in lush vertical gardens interweaving with dramatic, tilting, angular Expressionist structures, all bathed in warm golden light filtering through a glass dome. Electric crimson and electric blue LED filigree is integrated into the architecture. Chiaroscuro shadows are intense. The overall atmosphere is triumphant yet dramatic. Intense 35mm film grain, dynamic high dynamic range (HDR) lighting, heroic and pedagogical, with maternal affection implicit in his gaze.
